charter: Three simplified painted embossed metallic glyphs, bronze/silver/gold; compact deck and provision stowage fragments, not complete ships. Native designer icons used as style reference.
prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE tiny Victoria 3 ship designer equipment icon for wooden DECK AND PROVISION STOWAGE, no full ship. Input image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: native small painted metallic embossed equipment glyphs. Match thin dark bevel edge, simple broad silhouette, restrained metallic texture. A compact isolated simplified isometric wooden planked platform/deck fragment with provision casks, only 3 or 4 big essential shapes, readable at 32px. All parts in a SINGLE metallic tier palette (including planks and casks), no natural brown wood, white objects, text or scenic backdrop. Genuine transparent background outside glyph; opaque interiors, no aura, glow, bloom, haze, cast backdrop shadow, frame, badges, people, sails, mast, cannons, engines or sea. Keep complete icon inside canvas with generous transparent margins. Not a photorealistic illustration or detailed architectural drawing. LOW tier: warm copper BRONZE. One simple flat planked platform segment with ONE large hooped barrel and a smaller provision crate resting on it. A low rim suggests the existing hold. No raised deck or additional floor.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: SILVER middle-tier Victoria 3 ship designer deck/provision icon.
Input image 1: EDIT TARGET. The user explicitly APPROVES the architectural structure. Change ONLY the single crate and single upright barrel. Everything else must stay exactly as in input: both decks, planked floor, front beam, all support columns and their feet/collars, rear railing, perspective, position, dimensions, silhouette, brushwork, lighting, silver-blue palette, transparent canvas and framing. Do not reconstruct or move ANY part of the structure. The equal-height support geometry must remain intact.
Replace the existing crate at lower left/front with a clean squat rectangular wooden provision crate: closed lid, a few broad planks, thick straight framing and one simple diagonal brace. Lid and base are parallel, sides upright; its planar edges follow the SAME two isometric axes as the deck planks. Its whole bottom face rests flat on the existing lower deck. Keep roughly its existing position and footprint, do not place it under a pillar or obscure pillar feet.
Replace the existing barrel under the right part of the raised deck with a clear wooden stave cask: upright vertical axis, gently bulging symmetrical sides, broad curved staves, a fitted elliptical closed lid and TWO simple hoops. Top and bottom elliptical rims have consistent orientation. Keep the existing approximate position/footprint, with its bottom resting on the existing lower floor; the upper deck naturally occludes its upper/back area. No floating cask, impossible tilted lid, rivet clutter, spigot or extra barrels.
Both replacements must have the SAME restrained embossed painted monochrome SILVER-BLUE finish as the input; no natural brown wood or orange/gold elements. Simple broad silhouettes readable at 32px, NOT a realistic image or detailed plan. No added objects, labels, background, glow, haze or shadow backdrop. Preserve genuine background transparency. Again: ONLY rework the crate and barrel, leave the approved structure and viewpoint unchanged.

Visually compared to v4: deck corners, beam, column locations/foot contacts and railing remain aligned with approved structure. No claim of pixel-identical rendering outside the props. Inspected full-size and at 64/32px. Generated RGBA preserved without retouch. Bronze and gold unchanged; no runtime textures or game definitions changed.
